name: Village of Ossining
gaps: No floor-area or FAR limit for houses in the residential districts; no minimum lot depth in Table B-2
Side yards on lots wider than the minimum scale with lot width (both = 40% of width, each >= 45% of both); side_ft/side_total_ft hold the table minimums
No accessory apartment use found in Table A-2 (residential use table)

RDD sets no building front/side/rear yards (only 50 ft riverfront setback, 10 ft parking setback from side lines, 15 ft max setback from Westerly Road); residential units are not a listed use in RDD (Table A-1) and an RDD/SP-N moratorium article exists
CDD, IR, PW-a/b/c are development districts where residential units are conditional uses; yards there are uniform setbacks from any street or lot line
T district is under a zoning moratorium (Art. XXI, extended by L.L. 14-2026); bulk values are the current Table B-2 figures
L.L. 12-2026 (amends § 270-27 accessory buildings) and L.L. 10-2026 (amends § 270-34 landscaping/steep slopes) are adopted but not yet codified; accessory rules here follow L.L. 12-2026

wetlands.summary: Ch. 149: permit for regulated activities in wetlands, water bodies, watercourses and their buffer (100 ft from wetlands/water bodies, 50 ft from watercourses); zoning also requires a 25 ft buffer on each side of a watercourse (§ 270-27G).

steep_slopes.summary: § 270-34: for site-plan development, minimize construction on 15-25% slopes over 500 sf; no construction or regrading on 25%+ slopes over 500 sf without a Planning Board finding.

trees.summary: Ch. 248: permit to remove a private tree of 10 in.+ DBH, any significant tree, 3+ trees in a wetland or buffer, or clear-cut (5+ trees of 6 in.+ DBH on a lot in 12 months).

stormwater.summary: Ch. 227: SWPPP reviewed by the Stormwater Management Officer for land development and redevelopment activities as defined in § 227-6.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings in required side/rear yards: max 15 ft high, 5 ft from lot lines, max 750 sf combined and 30% of the yard; elsewhere: max 950 sf combined, 10 ft from lot lines; not nearer the street than the house (§ 270-27A, as amended by L.L. 12-2026).
general.pools: Rear yard only. In-ground: 15 ft from side and rear lines, 5 ft from the house, max 25% of the rear yard (§ 270-32). Aboveground: 10 ft from side and rear lines (measured from deck edge), max 45% of the rear yard (§ 270-33).
general.notes: Paved areas (other than access) must stay 15 ft from street lines and 4 ft from lot lines; front-yard fences max 3 ft (§ 270-27E). Indian Brook-Croton Gorge Watershed Protection Overlay (Art. XVII) and Historic districts (§ 270-25) add rules in mapped areas.

max_building_coverage.note: Combined building area of all buildings, excluding fully underground structures (§ 270-4)

max_impervious_coverage.note: Impervious coverage: % of land area covered by impervious surfaces (§ 270-4)

accessory.notes: In required side/rear yards: max 15 ft high, 5 ft from any lot line, max 750 sf combined and 30% of the required yard; elsewhere on the lot principal height applies, max 950 sf combined, 10 ft from any lot line; never nearer the street than the house (§ 270-27A as amended by L.L. 12-2026)

S-125.source: § 270-9E; Appendix B, Table B-2 (270 Attachment 4, Supp 53, Nov 2024)
S-125.notes: Lots wider than the minimum must have both side yards together equal to 40% of lot width, each at least 45% of that total (Table B-2). Min livable floor area 1,000 sf. Flag lots need 50 ft frontage. Corner lots need front yards on both streets; through lots on all street lines (§ 270-27B-C).
